description:
Create a strategic Wardley Map for a fintech cloud migration strategy. 

1. Open the file '~/Diagrams/wardley_map.drawio' which contains the map axes.
2. Read the specification in '~/Desktop/cloud_migration_strategy.txt'.
3. Add all 18 technology components as rounded rectangles at the specified Evolution (X) and Value Chain (Y) positions.
4. Draw the dependency links (solid lines) between components as listed.
5. Add the 6 evolution arrows (dashed/thick arrows) showing planned migration paths.
6. Color-code the components: User-Facing (Blue #4A90D9), Business Logic (Green #7AB648), Platform (Orange #F5A623), Data (Purple #9B59B6).
7. Add a Legend showing these categories.
8. Add the 3 strategic annotations mentioned in the spec.
9. Export the final map as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/exports/wardley_map_cloud_migration.pdf'.
